name: Environmental Policy, Law & Economics
summary: How societies govern the environment: laws, treaties, economic instruments, impact assessment and the science-policy interface.

topics.name: Environmental economics: externalities, public goods and valuation
Policy instruments: regulation, taxes, cap-and-trade and subsidies
Major environmental laws (e.g. clean air and clean water acts)

Risk, uncertainty and the precautionary principle
Environmental justice and governance of the commons
